name: Presidente Nereu (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a light blue shield bearing a tree, a church and a river, over a scroll reading PRESIDENTE NEREU TERRA PROMISSORA.
history: Presidente Nereu is a municipality in the state of Santa Catarina, Brazil. Flags of the World records that the flag and arms were created by Municipal Law No. 5 of 30 June 1976, the white field symbolising peace and harmony.
